notes.title: TFN: State of Update and Improvements (Info)
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

Advanced multi-genre has already been achieved, advanced formations and details are available, a professional animation system is at our disposal, and animation techniques have been perfected. The progress is shared with Bulletproof, and furthermore, The Fallen Night has some tricks up its sleeve to add a special touch, including a more realistic movement system (some improvements to the current system) and customized animations as an extra, especially for the MMORPG, and the MMORPG interface has been successfully incorporated.

However, there is a lot of work ahead, so I cannot promise an early update; nevertheless, every effort is being made to launch the update for The Fallen Night alongside the video games Eighteen Gold and Bulletproof this year, although Bulletproof takes priority. This is because in 2026 the production of Cromos and Eighteen will start at 100% with their new improvements that make your character come to life and behave similarly to a human being.

notes.title: TFN News: Update 2025 (Soon)
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

I'm sorry I didn't hear from the update, it wasn't possible to release the update at the beginning of the year, however The Fallen Night and Bulletproof share programming code so the progress is mutual, don't believe that I'm going to abandon The Fallen Night but know that it will be worth the wait since "Mass Interaction" is being incorporated,  in addition to this, the launch of the major update of The Fallen Night and the launch of Bulletproof and Eighteen Gold are being accelerated to start the production of Eighteen and Cromos, ATEG's biggest projects and the most promising games to date.

-The Fallen Night
The great improvement that awaits you in The Fallen Night is the interaction with animation, each action will be supported by an animation to give great realism, in addition to this various animations are implemented to come more life in the world.

-Eighteen & Cromos
These products are expensive because they include a lot of entertainment, systems, 3D models, animations, extensive maps and many hours of work to give the maximum detail and realism possible, in addition to their own laboratory, where you can modify the game to your liking, whether you like realism or be almost invincible, something I like is that in these products you can learn martial arts like in real life,  attending an academy, training and learning.

Here is a demo screenshot of the Bulletproof game and its progress in case you are interested. (There are approximately 165 Worlds)

notes.title: TFN: Update and Block System
notes.notes:
Attention gamers!

They will receive the update of The Fallen Night in December 2024 or January 2025, a destruction system is being used for the maps and weapons but this feature will be available later, we will have a sophisticated blocking system but it is not the official system with which we will get a blocking animation at any angle of 360° and in addition to the professional blocking animations, female characters are also incorporated that will soon be given more details about it but this feature will be available later and we will have in the update the infinite entertainment system, autonomous story and humanitarian, soon more will be talked about it, with infinite entertainment we will have story and secondary missions as long as we want and they are occasionally traveling around the map, This system is linked to autonomous story that allows you to generate more missions and create a story based on your actions.

notes.title: Eighteen: Early Release
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

Project Eighteen is back in production and we announced that the alternate edition will possibly be released by the end of 2024, although our priority is to release update 1.0.0.6 for The Fallen Night and release Bulletproof for Android and Windows.

For those who don't know Eighteen, it's the biggest project in the history of video games, using a powerful artificial intelligence capable of distinguishing even the smallest details of the player, using incredible activities and mini-games capable of hooking you for hours, in addition to a high level of interaction with the world capable of providing you with hours and hours of gameplay.  with a large content of approximately 250-350 GB of storage.

Minimum Requirements (Approximate):
Windows 64-Bits
Nvidia 1070 8GB
Intel i7 3.5Ghz
RAM: 32GB
Storage: 250-350GB
Price (Official): USD$125 (May have a reduced price if the launch version does not include as many systems or content, at least temporarily, as the price is adjusted according to your level of entertainment)

notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240913/803d9602e1511f66cd0efd1b484f0e5587b14081.png

I'm pleased to announce new improvements, the first-person perspective and crossbow usage already included in update 1.0.0.5, plus many improvements, the update is going to include Story (Early Access), MMORPG (Early Access), Brawls, Chess, Commander (Early Access) and Minigames, we are also doing business for distribution on PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43240913/c06382e7b0598e43e88a849579afac95222b7c97.png

The Fallen Night has become one of the biggest and most ambitious games from ATEG Studios, our storage indicates that its size is +100GB, however that doesn't mean that the game with the update will weigh +100GB, this is largely due to the mini-games and as I'm a big fan of TFN I can't help but add new improvements,  so I recommend keeping up to 120GB of storage available for its final version (GoldMaster).

When playing Skirmishes Online you will have to choose your perspective so that the game is fair, in 3rd person you will be able to fight watching your rear guard and better appreciating the attacks and in 1st person you will be able to fight with greater difficulty and immersion but you will not be able to see your rearguard, you can also choose a game with the Arquebusiers or without them, Keep in mind that armies are made up of different classes of soldiers, when choosing a class and a weapon you must take into account their advantages and disadvantages and by this I mean that Arquebusiers don't wear any armor and speed when aiming is reduced so that the game is fair, our system is based on the player's skills and not the character's skills but the game considers the weight of your weapon and armor, length, the edge of your weapon, the quality of your armor, your experience and based on that it provides you with better or worse results in combat, when playing Online keep in mind that your character will be affected by the damage and will leave you stunned by what your enemy can do. Take the opportunity to perform a lunge.

notes.title: TFN: Important Update On the Way
notes.notes:
Hello players!

The update 1.0.0.5 is ready but it will take a few days since we bring you an important improvement to enjoy TFN to the fullest, although the Story Mode is not available yet, we bring something great from the Story Mode with Early Access to it, it is about some works, with which we can earn money and XP to buy later in the Story Mode store and say that we are not lazy in the vast world of TFN.

Works:
Guard: Works as a guard at a lookout post, protecting valuables or denying access with a risk of invasion.
Patrol: Work patrolling the streets or forests of your territory with a platoon of 4 men with a risk of invasion.
Field Soldier: Work as a field soldier on high-risk missions, conducting sieges or assisting as reinforcements to your allies with a risk of being ambushed.
